# WoodEx — Custom Handcrafted Woodworking Workshop & CNC Digital Files

> WoodEx (https://woodex.store) is an artisan woodworking workshop based in Kyiv, Ukraine. Handcrafted live-edge tables, designer lighting, 3D relief wood carving, and digital STL/DXF files for CNC masters. Lead artisan and contact person: Mr. Andrii (пан Андрій).

## Contact & Direct Inquiry
- Website: https://woodex.store
- Phone / Telegram / Viber: +380979112973 (+38 (097) 911-29-73)
- Contact person: Mr. Andrii (пан Андрій)
- Production Facility: Kyiv, Ukraine
- Delivery: Kyiv direct courier, Nova Poshta across Ukraine, Worldwide shipping.

## Main Navigation & Documentation
- [Homepage (UK)](https://woodex.store/uk): WoodEx main showcase and interactive 3D configurator
- [Homepage (EN)](https://woodex.store/en): English version of WoodEx website
- [Catalog](https://woodex.store/uk/catalog): Full collection of solid wood products
- [Live Edge Tables](https://woodex.store/uk/catalog/tables): Handcrafted dining and coffee tables from natural wood slabs
- [Designer Lighting](https://woodex.store/uk/catalog/lighting): Oak and ash wooden chandeliers and wall sconces
- [Wood Carving & Wall Panels](https://woodex.store/uk/catalog/carving): 3D CNC and hand-carved decorative relief art
- [Digital CNC Store](https://woodex.store/uk/digital): Downloadable 3D models (STL, OBJ) and vector blueprints (DXF, SVG)
- [Portfolio Gallery](https://woodex.store/uk/portfolio): Finished custom projects and client showcases
- [Price Configurator](https://woodex.store/uk#order): Interactive 4-step custom wood furniture price calculator
- [About Workshop](https://woodex.store/uk/about): Workshop history, philosophy, and wood drying standards
- [Contact Page](https://woodex.store/uk/contact): Direct contact details, phone numbers, and workshop inquiry form

## Wood Materials & Standards
- Certified Ukrainian kiln-dried solid timber (8-10% moisture content).
- Premium European Oak, Caucasian Walnut, White Ash, and Wild Acacia.
- Eco-friendly Rubio Monocoat oil-wax matte finishes.
